article.headline: Radford wins 79-69 over South Carolina Upstate
article.description: — Brandon Maclin's 17 points helped Radford defeat South Carolina Upstate 79-69 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Radford wins 79-69 over South Carolina Upstate
article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Brandon Maclin's 17 points helped Radford defeat South Carolina Upstate 79-69 on Saturday. Maclin shot 6 for 10, including 5 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Highlanders (15-9, 5-4 Big South Conference). Truth Harris shot 3 of 8 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line to add 13 points. David Early shot 3 of 5 from the field and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. Brit Harris led the Spartans (5-19, 1-8) in scoring, finishing with 16 points. South Carolina Upstate got 14 points from Carmelo Adkins and 11 points from Karmani Gregory. The Spartans have lost seven straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
